headline: Baru Sahib's population is flat-to-shrinking and ~60% of it leaves for three weeks every winter, so ARY's +29% growth is coming from wallet share, not more people — and the largest untapped pool is not residents at all but the ~Rs 5.3-6.1 Cr/year of institutional food the Trust buys on this same campus, of which ARY supplies about 8%.
confidenceGap: Akal Academy Baru Sahib's current enrolment — the single largest cohort at ~28% of the township — is the one number I could not verify. I derived ~1,250 from the school's own published CBSE board registrations (Grade X = 98, Grade XII = 57) extrapolated across 15 grade levels; the only enrolment figure anyone publishes ("over 1,550") traces to ~2017 boilerplate from an era when its board cohorts were 40-50% larger. The true figure could sit anywhere in 1,100-1,450, which moves the township total by ±300. A second, independent ±487 hangs on whether AIRWE's rural women are counted inside Eternal University's 1,102 or are additive. Both are answerable in one phone call to the Trust.

findings.claim: Eternal University has 1,102 students, not the 2,500 that Wikipedia and every aggregator site repeats. The Trust's own website inflates it to 1,300.
findings.evidence: Eternal University 17th Annual Report 2024-25, 'STUDENTS PHYSICAL STRENGTH AS ON 31.07.2025' summary table: total 1102 (SC 212, ST 29, OBC 222, General 693; Himachali 565, non-Himachali 518, J&K 19). Also stated as 'Students' strength 1102' in the Facts & Figures table. https://eternaluniversity.edu.in/docs/CM0_1774326526_17_-_Annual_Report__2_.pdf . Contradicted by https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eternal_University (2,500) and https://barusahib.org/our-programs/higher-education/ (1,300).
findings.soWhat: Any ARY plan sized off the 2,500 figure over-forecasts the university cohort by 127%. This is the second-largest cohort in the township and it is less than half what the public record says.

findings.claim: Eternal University has not grown in a decade. It had 1,108 students in 2015-16 and 1,102 in 2024-25 — and it is filling only half its sanctioned seats.
findings.evidence: NAAC Self Study Report Q15: 'University departments UG 896 + PG 186 + research centres 26' and 'Constituent colleges 7 | 1108' for academic year 2015-16 (Q18 gives 187 working days, 2015-16). https://eternaluniversity.edu.in/docs/Eternal-University-NAAC-Self-Study-Report.pdf . Versus 1,102 in the 2024-25 Annual Report. Seat fill: same report's programme table, Grand Total 974 sanctioned seats vs 503 students admitted.
findings.soWhat: The university is not a growth engine for ARY and will not become one. It also means ~400 empty hostel beds (capacity ~1,500) — the campus has physical room to grow that the institutions are not filling.

findings.claim: Akal Academy Baru Sahib has shrunk sharply. Its own CBSE disclosure shows Grade X registrations down from 125 to 75-98 and Grade XII from 113 to 43-57.
findings.evidence: Akal Academy Baru Sahib (CBSE school code 43022, affiliation 630029), 'LAST THREE-YEARS RESULT OF THE BOARD EXAMINATION' PDF filed under CBSE Mandatory Public Disclosure: https://www.akalacademy.in/storage/2307/CBSE-Result.pdf . Class X registered: 112 (2017-18), 102, 125 (2019-20), 115, 81, 90, 75 (2023-24), 98 (2024-25). Class XII registered: 74, 113 (2018-19), 80, 75, 87, 56, 43 (2023-24), 63, 57 (2025-26).
findings.soWhat: The school is the biggest cohort in the township and it is contracting. ARY cannot plan on population-led growth; the customer base is getting smaller, not bigger.

findings.claim: Akal Academy Baru Sahib's current enrolment is roughly 1,250, not the 'over 1,550' that directory sites publish — that figure is ~2017-era boilerplate.
findings.evidence: Derived: board cohorts of 57-98 (source above) across ~15 grade levels (Nursery, LKG, UKG, I-XII). Cross-checks: 93 classrooms in the school's own CBSE infrastructure filing (https://www.akalacademy.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/School-Infrastructure.pdf, campus area 60,702 sq m, 40 girls + 40 boys toilets); 'over 1550 students from Nursery through XII' and 'around 150 NRI students' at https://www.schoolmykids.com/school/akal-academy-baru-sahib-sirmour-himachal-pradesh-india-s10011702 — but that page quotes 2017-18 fees, and in 2017-18 the Grade X cohort was 112 vs 98 now and Grade XII was 74 vs 57 now.
findings.soWhat: This is the largest single cohort and the weakest number in the whole build-up. It is worth one phone call to the Principal because it drives ARY's entire term-time demand base.

findings.claim: Roughly 60% of ARY's demand is a term-time population that physically leaves. Every winter the till drops to a hard, flat floor for about three weeks, then steps back up on a single day.
findings.evidence: ary query: SELECT CONVERT(date,VoucherDate) d, COUNT(*) bills, SUM(BillAmount) rs FROM SaleHeader WHERE VoucherDate>='2025-12-01' AND VoucherDate<'2026-03-01' GROUP BY CONVERT(date,VoucherDate). Term 1-23 Dec 2025: mean 1,066.7 bills/day, Rs 165,509/day. Then a 23-day plateau 29 Dec 2025 - 20 Jan 2026 held inside a 306-438 band: mean 376.3 bills/day, Rs 64,935/day. On 21 Jan it steps to 638 and climbs. Replicated on the two prior winters (same query to 2023-11-01): vacation/term = 47.2% / 49.0% / 35.3% on bills and 39.0% / 47.9% / 39.2% on revenue.
findings.number: Vacation floor = 35-49% of term demand (best-measured winter: 35.3% of bills, 39.2% of revenue)
findings.soWhat: This is the most reliable population measurement available and it is ARY's own data. It sets the permanent resident base at ~1,700-2,300 people and tells the buyer exactly when to stop buying: ~29 Dec to ~20 Jan.

findings.claim: The independent external cohort build-up and the till data agree on the resident/transient split — 39% non-student by headcount versus a 35-49% vacation floor by demand.
findings.evidence: Derived by reconciling two independent methods: (a) external cohorts — students 2,657 (EU 1,102 verified + Academy ~1,250 estimated + School of Spiritual Sciences 305 verified) against staff ~690 and staff family members ~1,000, giving non-students = 38.9% of a 4,347 resident core; (b) the measured vacation floor of 35-49% of demand from the query above.
findings.soWhat: Two methods that share no inputs landing in the same range is the strongest validation available here. It means the ~5,000 figure is sound and the permanent base is ~1,700-2,300 people.

findings.claim: Eternal University spends Rs 2.51 Cr a year on mess meals and staff boarding — and buys Rs 2.78 lakh a year from ARY, on the same campus. ARY has about 1% of it.
findings.evidence: EU 17th Annual Report 2024-25, Income & Expenditure: expenditure line 9 'Mess meal charges 196.00' lakh and line 11 'Boarding & lodging expenditure for EU faculty/staff 55.00' lakh (matched by income line 5 'Collection From Staff for Boarding & Lodging Services 55.00'). ARY side, ary query on SaleHeader joined to CustomerMaster for VoucherDate>='2025-08-01': Eternal University Rs 1.32 lakh + Apple A Day (a unit of Eternal University) Rs 0.69 lakh + Akal Nursing College Baru Sahib Rs 0.77 lakh = Rs 2.78 lakh.
findings.number: Rs 251 lakh/yr EU food spend vs Rs 2.78 lakh/yr bought from ARY = 1.1%
findings.soWhat: The single largest food buyer on ARY's own campus, with an audited budget, is 99% unserved. This needs no new location, no new population and no new licence.

findings.claim: Across the whole campus the Trust's institutional food and consumables budget is roughly Rs 5.3-6.1 Cr a year; ARY's institutional accounts total Rs 49.5 lakh — about 8-9%.
findings.evidence: ARY side VERIFIED by ary query (12 months to 2026-08-21, SaleHeader x CustomerMaster): Akal Academy 26.65, Kalgidhar Trust Baru Sahib 10.07, Akal Catering Services (Mess) 4.31, Akal De-Addiction Ward 2.44, Eternal University 1.32, Gurmat Camp 1.14, Akal Hospital 0.79, Akal Nursing College 0.77, Apple A Day 0.69, plus four canteen/Delhi accounts 0.99 = Rs 49.47 lakh. Budget side ESTIMATED by applying EU's own verified per-student mess rate (Rs 196 lakh / 1,102 = Rs 17,786/student/yr) to the other resident cohorts (Academy ~1,250, Spiritual Sciences 305, AIRWE 487) plus EU's Rs 55 lakh staff boarding.
findings.number: Rs 528-614 lakh/yr estimated budget; Rs 49.47 lakh/yr captured = 8.1-9.4%
findings.soWhat: This is the largest single expansion pool found in this lane and it is B2B on ground ARY already occupies. Ten points of capture is roughly Rs 55 lakh a year.

findings.claim: 14.5% of ARY's current-year revenue comes from nine bills to one Delhi organisation that has nothing to do with the 5,000 residents. Every per-resident metric in circulation is inflated by it.
findings.evidence: ary customers get 002CM -> 'Hunger Heroes', Green Park Main, New Delhi 110016, credit_allowed true, 20 visits. ary query bucketing SaleHeader for VoucherDate>='2026-04-01': walk-in Cash (00001) 162,434 bills / Rs 251.41 lakh / 71.09%; Hunger Heroes (002CM) 9 bills / Rs 51.38 lakh / 14.53%; all other named accounts 6,438 bills / Rs 50.87 lakh / 14.38%. Its bills run Rs 4.35-6.88 lakh each, 7,355-11,900 units, booked on the Basement counter at Ary Baru Sahib.
findings.number: Rs 51.38 lakh across 9 bills = 14.53% of FY26-27 revenue to date
findings.soWhat: The briefed 'Rs 1,493 spend/resident/month' and 'Rs 208 average bill' mix wholesale into a retail denominator. Resident-facing spend is nearer Rs 1,290/resident/month, and the real retail bill count is what matters for staffing.

findings.claim: The Basement counter is not a shop — it is a single wholesale channel. 22 bills in its entire life, Rs 1.06 Cr, and 20 of them are Hunger Heroes.
findings.evidence: ary query on SaleDetail x SaleHeader grouped by WarehouseID: WH 16 (Basement) 22 bills, first 2025-04-23, last 2026-08-03, Rs 105.64 lakh. Grouped by customer within WH 16: 002CM Hunger Heroes 20 bills Rs 104.67 lakh; 0000L 2 bills Rs 0.96 lakh. Average Rs 4.8 lakh per bill.
findings.number: 22 bills, Rs 105.64 lakh lifetime, Rs 4.8 lakh average bill
findings.soWhat: ARY already knows how to run a bulk institutional channel — it just points at Delhi instead of at the Trust's own messes 200 metres away. The capability exists; the customer targeting does not.

findings.claim: ARY has a second captive Trust campus it has abandoned: Akal University, Talwandi Sabo, grew from 2,172 to 2,703 students while ARY's counter there sat closed since 11 July 2024.
findings.evidence: Location and identity: https://barusahib.org/our-programs/higher-education/ — 'The Society has two universities under higher education, namely, Eternal University, Baru Sahib and Akal University, Talwandi Sabo.' Enrolment: https://barusahib.org/our-impact/year-end-report-2025/ counters, '753 STUDENTS getting academic Scholarships out of 2,703' and '617 FREE/SUBSIDIZED STUDENTS out of 2,703 in current session'; the 2024 report says 'out of 2172'. Closure: ary query grouped by WarehouseID — WH 14 'Talwandi Sabo' 91,229 bills, Rs 51.24 lakh, first 2023-04-02, last 2024-07-11; WH 17 'Girls Canteen Ts' 10,867 bills, Rs 5.13 lakh, last 2024-03-22. ARY already holds Bathinda GSTIN 03AACCJ4223F1Z6.
findings.number: 2,172 -> 2,703 students (+24.4%); counter dark 13.5 months; prior run-rate Rs 3.35 lakh/month
findings.soWhat: A growing captive campus, an existing legal entity, a live GSTIN and a proven trading history — the cheapest population expansion available, and it needs no new market entry.

findings.claim: ARY also lost the Eternal University cafeteria. EU's 2024-25 annual report still names 'Apple a-day' as its campus cafeteria, but ARY's Apple A Day counter died in November 2023 and the name now appears only as a customer.
findings.evidence: EU 17th Annual Report 2024-25: 'The library, computer center, gymnasium, Wi-Fi, bank, ATM, post office, courier service, cafeteria Apple a-day) ... have been set up in the campus.' ARY side: ary query grouped by WarehouseID — WH 13 'Ary Apple A Day' 27,178 bills, Rs 38.43 lakh, first 2023-04-01, last 2023-11-30, warehouse now active=false. And in the customer master, 'Apple A Day A U/O Eternal University' bought Rs 0.69 lakh from ARY in the last 12 months.
findings.number: Counter closed 30-Nov-2023 after Rs 38.43 lakh / 27,178 bills; now a Rs 0.69 lakh/yr customer
findings.soWhat: ARY went from operating the university's cafeteria to supplying it at a trickle. Whatever happened there is worth Rs 3-4 lakh a month of throughput and is the same conversation as the mess contract.

findings.claim: There are essentially no babies being served. ARY's entire annual diaper volume would supply about one infant, and infant formula is a dead category with 28 SKUs listed.
findings.evidence: ary query on SaleDetail x SaleHeader x ProductMaster for VoucherDate>='2025-08-01': 11 diaper SKUs, 425 packs total, Rs 34,124 for the year (Rs 2,844/month); packs are tiny (2-8 pants each), so ~2,271 diapers/year against ~1,825 for one baby at 5/day. Formula and weaning: 28 Cerelac/Lactogen/NAN SKUs all flagged active, 13 packs sold in 12 months, Rs 3,878 total; every Lactogen SKU sold zero. Baby toiletries by contrast do move (~Rs 94,000/yr of Johnson's and Himalaya soap, shampoo, talc, oil plus ~Rs 35,000 of wipes).
findings.number: 425 diaper packs and 13 formula packs in 12 months; Rs 38,002/yr combined
findings.soWhat: Either the under-6 cohort is much smaller than 'families with babies and small children' implies, or these families buy every nappy and tin 30-50 km away. Both readings are actionable and the toiletries data says the customers exist.

findings.claim: The campus is 450 acres and already has the amenities of a small town — SBI branch with ATM, post office, courier, stationery and book shop, market area, guest houses, and a 100-bed hospital with 11 doctors and 3 ambulances.
findings.evidence: NAAC SSR, student handbook section: 'The EU is totally residential as all the students are required to live on the campus which has about 450 acres area at Baru Sahib (District Sirmour H.P.) ... guest houses for visitors and parents, shopping/market area, bank and post office etc.' Facilities checklist: 'Facilities like banking..... YES, State Bank of India with ATM', 'Post office......... YES', 'Stationary and book shop... Yes'. Health centre: '(i) University has a 100 Bed Hospital in the campus. (ii) 11 fully Medically Qualified Doctors- Physio-therapist, and qualified para-medical staff. (iii) A fleet of three Ambulance'. Confirmed current by the 2024-25 Annual Report listing 'bank, ATM, post office, courier service'.
findings.number: 450 acres; 100 beds; 11 doctors; 3 ambulances; 1 SBI branch + ATM; 1 post office
findings.soWhat: Banking, cash and logistics infrastructure already exist on site, so credit, digital collection and inbound freight are not blockers. It also means a competing 'General & Wellness Store' is named on campus — worth confirming who runs it.

findings.claim: Eternal University is 100% residential and its hostels have ~400 spare beds. Every enrolled student lives on campus.
findings.evidence: NAAC SSR: 'University has six hostels one for Boys and five Girls to accommodate around 1500 students.' Occupancy table: boys' hostel 1, inmates 53; girls' hostels 3, inmates 1054 — total 1,107 against a then-enrolment of 1,108. Student handbook: 'The EU is totally residential as all the students are required to live on the campus.'
findings.number: Capacity ~1,500; occupied 1,107 of 1,108 students; ~400 beds spare
findings.soWhat: There is no day-scholar leakage at the university — 100% of its students sleep, eat and shop on ARY's doorstep. The spare beds are the only organic upside in the resident count.

findings.claim: The campus hosts at least three more resident institutions nobody counted: 305 students at the School of Spiritual Sciences, 487 women at AIRWE, and a drug de-addiction ward.
findings.evidence: https://barusahib.org/our-programs/school-of-spiritual-sciences/ counters: 305 Students Studying, 4 bands of Kirtan Jathas, 120 Teachers Recruited. https://barusahib.org/our-programs/women-empowerment/ counter: '487 + Women Currently Enrolled at AIRWE'. Corroborated by the Academy's own annual report: 'About 500 girls from rural parts of India, study here in this unique programme and their expenses are met entirely by The Kalgidhar Trust' (https://www.akalacademy.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Annual-Report-amended.pdf), which also names the campus institutions as 'Akal Academy, Ashram, AIRWE, Gurmat Vidyalaya for boys' alongside Eternal University and Akal College of Nursing. De-addiction unit: https://barusahib.org/our-programs/drug-and-alcohol-rehabilitation-center/ lists 'Akal Psychiatry Cum Drug De-Addiction and Rehabilitation Center, Baru Sahib, Via Rajgarh'; the 2025 year-end report reports 5,571 OPD and 218 IPD patients there.
findings.number: 305 + 487 + a de-addiction ward; ARY already bills 'Akal De-Adiction Ward' Rs 2.44 lakh/yr and 'Gurmat Camp Baru Sahib' Rs 1.14 lakh/yr
findings.soWhat: AIRWE's 487 are almost certainly inside EU's 1,102 (they take their degrees at EU, and 487 closely tracks EU's 518 non-Himachali students), but the 305 spiritual-sciences students are additive and separately unserved.

findings.claim: The Trust employs 4,409 teachers across its network and trains them at Baru Sahib, so the campus carries a rotating adult population over and above its residents.
findings.evidence: https://barusahib.org/our-programs/women-empowerment/ counters: '4409 Teachers Employed', '487 + Women Currently Enrolled at AIRWE', '100% All heads of Akal Academies are Women', '90% of the Teaching Staff of Akal Academies are Women'. https://barusahib.org/our-impact/year-end-report-2025/: '43 teachers employed' and '487 teachers in training' under the AIRWE heading. Wikipedia notes a 'Teacher Training Centre, Baru Sahib'; the Trust's journey page dates 'Akal Institute of Teacher Training' to 2007.
findings.number: 4,409 network teachers; 487 in training at Baru Sahib; Trust network 130 schools / 75,000 students
findings.soWhat: Baru Sahib is the HQ of a 75,000-student network, so training cohorts, sewadars and visiting staff pass through constantly. That transient adult footfall is real demand ARY can plan around but has never sized.

findings.claim: The 100-bed charitable hospital brings ~120 outside patients a day onto the campus — a footfall stream that is not in the 5,000 and not in ARY's plan.
findings.evidence: https://barusahib.org/our-programs/charitable-hospital/ counters: '100 bedded Hospital at Baru Sahib', '45000 Patients treated free annually in OPD and 4-5 medical camps', '265 Patients operate free in 4-5 multi surgical camps at Baru Sahib'; the page states it caters to patients 'residing as far as 100 km'. Year-end report 2025: 43,706 treated free in OPD, 1,375 in IPD, 2,390 in medical camps; year-end 2024: 47,848 OPD, 1,329 IPD. ARY's own 'Akal Hospital Baru Sahib' account buys just Rs 0.79 lakh/yr.
findings.soWhat: Patients and attendants from a 100 km catchment arrive on foot at a campus with one shop. This is incremental non-resident retail footfall that costs ARY nothing to serve and is currently invisible in its planning.

recommendations.action: Go after the Eternal University mess and boarding contract. Its own audited annual report puts the spend at Rs 2.51 Cr/year (Rs 196 lakh mess meals + Rs 55 lakh staff boarding) and ARY currently bills EU, its Nursing College and its Apple A Day cafeteria a combined Rs 2.78 lakh/year. Walk in with EU's own published figure and bid for a defined share (rice, atta, pulses, oil, sugar, tea, vegetables), not the whole contract.
recommendations.blocker: ARY has no institutional rate card, because StandardCostPrice is set on only 41 of 19,481 active SKUs — it cannot quote a bulk price and know its own margin. Populate cost for the top 200 staples first.

recommendations.action: Reopen the Talwandi Sabo counter serving Akal University. The student body has grown 2,172 -> 2,703 (+24%) since ARY walked away on 11-Jul-2024, the Bathinda GSTIN 03AACCJ4223F1Z6 is already live, and the counter has 91,229 bills of trading history at Rs 3.35 lakh/month. Reopen the Girls Canteen Ts at the same time.
recommendations.blocker: Nobody has established WHY it closed. Find that out before spending a rupee — if it closed on losses or a licence problem, the same cause is still there.

recommendations.action: Build one named institutional-sales role covering the whole campus: Akal Academy's mess (Rs 26.65 lakh/yr today against an estimated Rs 222 lakh budget), the School of Spiritual Sciences, AIRWE, the hospital and the de-addiction ward. Total campus budget is an estimated Rs 5.3-6.1 Cr against Rs 49.5 lakh captured — moving 8-9% to 25% is roughly Rs 90 lakh a year.
recommendations.blocker: Same cost-price gap as above, plus there is no owner: institutional buying currently arrives as walk-in credit bills rather than as managed accounts.

recommendations.action: Recover the Eternal University cafeteria relationship. EU's 2024-25 annual report still lists 'Apple a-day' as its campus cafeteria while ARY's Apple A Day counter has been dark since 30-Nov-2023 and the name now appears only as a Rs 0.69 lakh/year customer. Either re-take the operation or become its sole supplier.
recommendations.blocker: Find out who runs it now — the SSR also names a 'General & Wellness Store' on campus, so there may be a competitor ARY has never identified.

recommendations.action: Stop reporting per-resident metrics on gross turnover. Split ARY's P&L into resident retail and wholesale: 14.53% of FY26-27 revenue is nine bills to Hunger Heroes in Delhi. Restate spend per resident (~Rs 1,290/month, not Rs 1,493) and average bill before any assortment decision is taken off those numbers.
recommendations.blocker: none — one flag on customer 002CM and the Basement counter in the reporting

recommendations.action: Run the buying and rostering calendar off the measured term cycle rather than the fiscal one. Demand collapses to 35-39% of term for about 23 days from ~29 Dec to ~20 Jan and returns on a single day (21 Jan 2026: 438 -> 638 bills). Cut perishable and snack intake for that window, take stock-count and maintenance downtime inside it, and stop treating January as underperformance.
recommendations.blocker: none — the vacation dates need confirming with the Academy and EU each year, since the 2024-25 window ran longer (28 Dec - 8 Feb)

recommendations.action: Fix the baby and infant category, or formally drop it. ARY sold 425 diaper packs (Rs 34,124) and 13 packs of formula/weaning food (Rs 3,878) in twelve months, while 28 Cerelac and Lactogen SKUs sit listed and every Lactogen sold zero — yet baby toiletries turn ~Rs 94,000/year, so the customers exist. Get the count of children under 6 from the Trust's estate office first.
recommendations.blocker: Nobody knows how many children under 6 live on campus. Ask the Trust estate office for quarters-wise family composition — the single cheapest population fact still missing.

recommendations.action: Pin the Akal Academy Baru Sahib enrolment and boarder/day split with one call to the Principal (Kapil Talwar) or the Trust's own ERP at kalgidhartrust.info/akal_erp. It is the largest cohort in the township at ~28%, it is contracting (Grade XII registrations 113 -> 57), and every demand forecast rests on an estimate.
recommendations.blocker: none — the school publishes a phone number, 01799-276031, on its CBSE affiliation letter

recommendations.action: Size the hospital footfall as a distinct customer segment. 43,706 free OPD patients a year (~120/day) plus attendants arrive from a 100 km catchment onto a campus with one shop, and none of them are in the 5,000. Test a small front-of-hospital range: ready food, fruit, water, blankets, toiletries, phone top-ups.
recommendations.blocker: No footfall or basket data exists for this group — run a two-week manual count at the hospital gate before committing space.

openQuestions: Are AIRWE's 487 women counted inside Eternal University's 1,102, or additive? This alone moves the student body between 2,657 and 3,144. The Trust's Annual Report says they receive 'higher education at the Eternal University', and 487 closely tracks EU's 518 non-Himachali students, which is why I treated them as inside — but it is unproven. Ask the EU Registrar or the AIRWE director.

What is Akal Academy Baru Sahib's actual current enrolment, and the boarder vs day-scholar split? I could only derive ~1,250 from published board-exam registrations. Ask the Principal (Kapil Talwar, 01799-276031) or read the Trust's own ERP at kalgidhartrust.info/akal_erp (currently 403 to the public).

How many people does The Kalgidhar Trust actually employ at Baru Sahib, across the Academy, EU, hospital, de-addiction centre, mess, housekeeping, laundry, security, farm and dairy? No source publishes a campus headcount. My ~690 is the weakest number in the build-up. Trust HR or the estate office.

How many of the '200+ family accommodations' are occupied, and what is their family composition — specifically children under 6? This decides whether the baby category is a real Rs 50,000/month opportunity or a rounding error. Trust estate office, quarters-wise.

Why did the Talwandi Sabo, Girls Canteen Ts and Apple A Day counters actually close? Three closures in nine months (Nov-2023, Mar-2024, Jul-2024) looks like a decision, not an accident. ARY management and the Bathinda accounts.

Is there a competing store on campus? The NAAC SSR lists a 'General & Wellness Store' among campus amenities and EU's report names a cafeteria ARY no longer runs. If a rival or a Trust-run store operates there, every wallet-share number in this analysis needs a new denominator.

What are the Akal Academy's and the Trust's actual food and consumables procurement budgets? I extrapolated Rs 528-614 Cr-scale figures from Eternal University's verified Rs 17,786/student/year. The real budgets would make the institutional case exact instead of indicative. Trust finance.
